ModMetaData.name: Skoltroy - Missiles Turrets
ModMetaData.author: Skoltroy
ModMetaData.description:
Spun out from "Rimmu-Nation - Security" by Chicken Plucker https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2011774401 (1.0, 1.1, 1.2)
"Rimmu-Nation² - Security" by Chicken Plucker https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2563504596 (1.3, does not include this turret)
--
Though CP has updated his various Rimmu-Nation mods, he decided to leave the SSM Turret behind for various reasons; among them, some complained it was too overpowered. However, I have seen some people specifically requesting it, so I decided to spin it out into its own mod. I myself am a big fan of overpowered, unbalanced stuff, especially when it's as well done as this. All credit to Chicken Plucker for this and his other fantastic, detailed mods, old and new.
I generally ask for forgiveness rather than permission, but either way my policy is clear: if the original modder requests it, I will remove this update.
